record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, scale each feed-forward residual contribution by 0.5: x = x + 0.5*FFN(LayerNorm(x)). Keep attention residuals unchanged, retaining pre-norm bidirectional attention, GELU, 2× feed-forward width and final LayerNorm. Attenuating feed-forward updates may extend the successful capacity reduction without the extra parameters of the unsuccessful SwiGLU trial. Preserve features, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer; use the identical architecture in the predictor.
